questions.question: What parable opens Isaiah 5?
options: The parable of the lost and wandering sheep
The song of the vineyard that yielded wild grapes
The riddle of the eagle and the cedar
The story of the rich man and his lamb
questions.answer: The song of the vineyard that yielded wild grapes

questions.question: What does the vineyard represent?
options: The pagan nations all surrounding the land
The house of Israel and the men of Judah
The priests who served at the temple
The kings of Assyria and Babylon
questions.answer: The house of Israel and the men of Judah

questions.question: Isaiah 5 pronounces a series of woes, including on those who call evil good and good evil.
He looked for justice, but behold, _____; for righteousness, but behold, an outcry!
Woe to those who call evil good and good _____.
